standard.summary: Schedule-Free 内置预热步数（与外部调度器的 warmup 独立；0 = 关闭）。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Schedule-Free's built-in warmup step count (independent of an external scheduler's warmup; 0 = off).
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: Schedule-Free 内置预热步数（与外部 lr_warmup_steps 叠加）。推荐与 lr_warmup_steps 保持一致。

advanced_en.principle: Schedule-Free's built-in warmup steps (stacks with external lr_warmup_steps). Recommended to match lr_warmup_steps.
